clue.text: Less than a thousand dine wretchedly when subverted

indicators.note: something done wretchedly is done badly, so the letters come out in a poor, jumbled order

blocks.note: less than is below, or under
M is the Roman numeral for a thousand
the letters of dine, rearranged

explanation.surface: A diner on a modest budget eats miserably when their plans are thwarted.
explanation.definitionFit: To undermine a cause is to weaken or sabotage it secretly, just as subverting does.

clue.text: Former Croatian, perhaps, brings poor Val's guy round

indicators.note: poor suggests something in bad shape, so the letters are knocked out of their order

blocks.note: the letters of the two words, to be rearranged
a round thing is shaped like the letter O

explanation.surface: A man from Croatia wins over the boyfriend of a woman called Val.
explanation.walkthrough: Croatia was part of Yugoslavia until 1991, so a Croatian of that era was a Yugoslav; 'perhaps' marks the definition as an example.
explanation.definitionFit: Before the federation broke up, people from Croatia held Yugoslav citizenship, making a Croatian one example.

clue.text: No one beat upstanding people

indicators.note: in a down entry, standing up means the letters read from bottom to top

blocks.note: taken as written
I is the Roman numeral for one
to tan someone's hide is to beat them

explanation.surface: Nobody managed to defeat the honest, upright folk.
explanation.definitionFit: A nation is a whole people united by shared history, language or territory.

clue.text: Look, love, first go to the French!

indicators.note: first asks for only the opening letter of the following word

blocks.note: love is zero in tennis scoring, shaped like the letter O
the opening letter of go
le is a French word for the

explanation.surface: An excited suggestion to a sweetheart: let's head off to France first.
explanation.definitionFit: To ogle is to stare at someone, usually with open desire, so it is a kind of looking.

clue.text: Study of the whole pack? On, just hearts

definitions.text: Study of the whole pack? On, just hearts

blocks.note: surface reading: the study of an entire deck of playing cards, as if a card game
setter's reading: the subject concentrates only on the heart, the organ rather than the suit

explanation.surface: A card player wonders whether to study the full deck, then decides to focus on one suit only.
explanation.walkthrough: The answer begins with the letters of a playing card, so it looks like 'card study', but the field is the medical study of the heart.
explanation.definitionFit: This is the branch of medicine dealing with the heart and its diseases, hence studying hearts.

clue.text: Not well, alights on barren terrain

blocks.note: feeling bad means feeling unwell
a bird that alights comes down, or lands

explanation.surface: Someone feeling poorly gets off and finds themselves on desolate ground.
explanation.definitionFit: Badlands are eroded, arid regions with little vegetation, such as those in the American West.

clue.text: Art gallery for the blind, for example

blocks.note: first meaning: the great museum of art in Paris
second meaning: a set of angled slats in a window, as found in a type of window blind

explanation.surface: A museum that caters for visitors who cannot see.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface suggests a gallery accessible to blind people; here the blind is a window covering made of slats.
explanation.definitionFit: The Paris museum shares its name with the slatted shutter used in blinds and ventilation panels.

clue.text: Have young animal

blocks.note: first meaning: to give birth to offspring
second meaning: a large furry mammal

explanation.surface: Instruction to own a juvenile creature.
explanation.definitionFit: The verb means to give birth to children, and the noun names a large heavy mammal with shaggy fur.

clue.text: Nag Laurie about type of complaint

indicators.note: about suggests turning things around, so the letters are moved into a new order

blocks.note: the letters of the two words, to be rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone pesters a man called Laurie about some kind of grievance.
explanation.walkthrough: Complaint here is a medical word for an ailment, not a grumble.
explanation.definitionFit: Neuralgia is intense pain along a nerve, an ailment, which doctors call a complaint.

clue.text: Only an advance, it's said

indicators.note: it's said means the words are to be spoken, matching another word by sound

blocks.note: an advance of money is a loan

explanation.surface: Someone stresses that they are asking for just a little money up front.
explanation.definitionFit: Alone and only both mean solely, with nothing or nobody else, as in 'he alone knew'.

clue.text: Oriental reason for moving

blocks.note: E for eastern
a motive is a reason for acting

explanation.surface: An Eastern explanation for relocating somewhere.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Reason for moving' reads as a whole phrase, but moving is the definition in the emotional sense.
explanation.definitionFit: Emotive language stirs the feelings, which is what moving means when describing a speech or scene.

clue.text: Free, but maligned on return

indicators.note: returning means going back the way it came, so the word is read backwards

blocks.note: to revile is to malign or abuse verbally

explanation.surface: A prisoner is released, only to be badmouthed when they come back home.
explanation.definitionFit: To deliver someone from danger or captivity is to set them free, as in 'deliver us from evil'.

clue.text: Fruit or lemon squash

indicators.note: squashing something crushes it out of shape, so the letters are mixed

blocks.note: the letters of lemon, to be rearranged

explanation.surface: A choice between a piece of fruit or a lemon-flavoured drink.
explanation.walkthrough: Lemon squash is a British soft drink made from concentrate, which disguises squash as an indicator.
explanation.definitionFit: A melon is a large juicy fruit of the gourd family, such as a cantaloupe or watermelon.

clue.text: Fuss navy intended, it's said, to obtain decorations

definitions.note: plural definition for a singular answer, which can be a mass noun

indicators.note: it's said means the preceding word is replaced by one that sounds the same

blocks.note: ado is fuss or bother
RN is the Royal Navy
intended means meant

explanation.surface: A fuss about the navy's plans to receive medals.
explanation.definitionFit: Adornment is ornamentation in general, the decorations added to make something more attractive.

clue.text: Opening hours in which to retrieve information?

definitions.text: Opening hours in which to retrieve information?

blocks.note: surface reading: the times when a library or office is open to the public
setter's reading: a computing term for the delay in fetching data from storage

explanation.surface: A library's opening times, when visitors can come and look things up.
explanation.walkthrough: The question mark flags that the opening hours are not a library's but a computer's.
explanation.definitionFit: In computing this phrase is the time taken for a storage device to locate and return requested data.

clue.text: Counter drunken hint

blocks.note: tiddly is British slang for slightly drunk
a wink is a knowing hint

explanation.surface: Someone opposes a clue dropped by a drunk.
explanation.walkthrough: Counter looks like a verb meaning oppose; it is a noun, the small disc used in a game.
explanation.definitionFit: This is one of the small plastic discs flicked into a cup in a children's game, a kind of counter.

clue.text: Ban all Quiptics for perfect harmony!

blocks.note: first meaning: a call for no puzzles at all, read as a slogan
second meaning: a relationship without a single angry exchange

explanation.surface: A tongue-in-cheek campaign to abolish this very puzzle series in the name of peace.
explanation.walkthrough: The setter makes a joke against their own puzzle; the answer splits two ways, as a puzzle and as an angry remark.
explanation.definitionFit: Saying a couple never exchanged an angry remark describes complete harmony, while also forbidding any puzzles.

clue.text: Again, unrestricted tall grass engulfs Frank

indicators.note: to engulf is to swallow up, so one word surrounds the other

blocks.note: a reed is a tall grass growing by water
frank and open both mean candid

explanation.surface: Once more, long grass grows freely over a man named Frank.
explanation.definitionFit: Something reopened is unrestricted once more, as a road or shop allowed to operate again.

clue.text: High above the boss

blocks.note: over means above
the head is the person in charge

explanation.surface: Someone ranks loftily above their manager.
explanation.definitionFit: Overhead means situated up in the air above you, as with lights or wires placed high.

clue.text: Videos duly reorganised after 500 removed slyly

indicators.note: reorganised means arranged differently, so the letters take a new order
removed means taken away, so those letters drop out of the fodder

blocks.note: the letters of the two words, as fodder
D is the Roman numeral for 500

explanation.surface: Tapes are rearranged once someone has pocketed a large sum, cunningly.
explanation.walkthrough: Videos duly has two Ds; one goes, and the remaining nine letters are reshuffled.
explanation.definitionFit: Acting deviously means acting in an underhand, cunning way, which is what slyly describes.

clue.text: In respect for envoy, agency offered a journey

indicators.note: in says the answer sits inside the words that follow

blocks.note: surface padding: it builds the picture and gives no letters
found across the two words, ignoring the comma

explanation.surface: Out of respect for a diplomat, a travel agency laid on a trip.
explanation.definitionFit: A voyage is a long journey, especially one made by sea or into space.

clue.text: Period charm

blocks.note: first meaning: a stretch of time
second meaning: a magic incantation

explanation.walkthrough: Period charm reads like the appeal of an antique; the words are two separate meanings.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means both a short stretch of time, as in a dry stint, and a magic formula or incantation.

clue.text: Athletic singer?

blocks.note: first meaning: fond of or good at games
second meaning: the nickname of one of the Spice Girls

explanation.walkthrough: The Spice Girls were a 1990s British pop group whose members went by nicknames; one was Sporty Spice, so the question mark flags a singer known by the word.
explanation.definitionFit: The adjective describes someone keen on games and fitness, and it was also a pop singer's nickname.

clue.text: Settlement's confined around May, perhaps

indicators.note: around says one word sits on either side of another
perhaps hints the word may appear in some other form, so its letters are rearranged

blocks.note: pent, as in pent-up, means shut in
the letters of May, rearranged

explanation.surface: A village is shut in during the spring month.
explanation.definitionFit: A payment settles a debt, and to settle a bill means to pay it, so settlement is a synonym.

clue.text: Mountain to take a look at, they say

indicators.note: they say means what people speak, so the word is matched by sound

blocks.note: to peek is to take a quick look

explanation.surface: A recommended mountain to go and see.
explanation.definitionFit: A peak is the pointed summit of a mountain, and by extension a mountain itself.

clue.text: Special skill said to involve no method

indicators.note: said means the words are spoken, so the answer matches them by sound

blocks.note: a method is a how, so no method is no how

explanation.surface: Expertise is reputed to need no particular system.
explanation.definitionFit: Know-how is practical expertise, the specialised ability to get something done.

clue.text: Join knight outside in turn

indicators.note: a turn sends something back the other way, so the word is read backwards
outside says one piece wraps around the other

blocks.note: KT is the abbreviation for knight
the word in, read backwards

explanation.surface: Chess advice: link up the knight on the outside, then move.
explanation.definitionFit: To knit is to join together closely, as broken bones knit or a team is closely knit.

clue.text: Fish in corner

blocks.note: first meaning: to fish with rod and line
second meaning: the space where two lines meet

explanation.surface: A fish lurking in a corner of the tank.
explanation.definitionFit: As a verb it means to fish with a hook, and as a noun the space between two meeting lines, such as a corner.

clue.text: Heard man is to study postal transport

indicators.note: heard means what reaches the ear, so the next word is replaced by one sounding alike

blocks.note: a man is a male
to train is to study for a skill

explanation.surface: Word has it a man is going to read up on how letters are carried.
explanation.definitionFit: A mail train was a railway service carrying letters and parcels, hence a means of postal transport.
